questions.explanation: One petal area = π/2? Actually ∫0^{π/2} 1/2·4 sin^2(2θ)dθ = 1/2? compute: 2∫ sin^2(2θ)dθ from 0 to π/2 = 2·π/4 = π/2 ≈1.571. The slip is 2π.
questions.hint: Integrate half square over one petal.
